I wonder what is your current assessment of this PR @poyoho. If we would like to avoid possible regressions, I think the best would be to queue it for Vite 3.0 (We may start the beta in around two weeks so I'm currently leaning towards this option). If there is some straightforward fix that you would like to extract from this PR to be applied in 2.9, maybe that is also an option. What do you think? 2.9 looks quite solid to me... maybe we should already start focusing our efforts in 3.0

In this PR, I reverted the `import.meta.url` all content (contained `renderChunk` hook replace), So I think this PR is like a patch.

Fix the following: 
1. `import.meta.glob` will transform to dynamic import, so only support `format: es` and `module worker`.
1. `import.meta.globEager` will transform to static import, so only support `format: iife|es` and `module worker`.
1. supplement unit-test for `worker constructor` in nested worker and simple worker.
1. fix clean worker source map warning. (emit same file many times)
1. fix inline worker source map 404 (inline worker `self.location.href` base on site base. make it use absolute paths.)

And about `import.meta.url` in worker. 

> `import.meta.url` build with es it will replace with [esbuild minify](https://hyrious.me/esbuild-repl/?version=0.14.36&mode=transform&input=self.postMessage%28%22A+string%2Fes%2F%22%2Bimport.meta.url%29%3Bconsole.log%28%22url-worker.js%22%29%3B%0A&options=--minify+--format%3Desm+--target%3Dchrome63) will got an unexpected data.

This can be solved only by upgrading the [target of esbuild](https://hyrious.me/esbuild-repl/?version=0.14.36&mode=transform&input=self.postMessage%28%22A+string%2Fes%2F%22%2Bimport.meta.url%29%3Bconsole.log%28%22url-worker.js%22%29%3B%0A&options=--minify+--format%3Desm+--target%3Dchrome64).

> `import.meta.url` build with iife it will polyfill with rollup will be used document in the worker

Rollup should set `format: "es"` to avoid it.

Discussing this problem, we can ignore the classic worker because it can't work in dev. I think it can be preset that the user has already set a higher version of the target.

`format: es` should need to setting higher version of the target. So I think it is ok.

`format: iife` after setting higher version of the target it also output [compatible code](https://rollupjs.org/repl/?version=2.70.1&) I think `format: "iife"` can still be replaced.
I've done something similar, but it's really a little difficult

issue_context.title: import.meta.glob doesn't work in webworker in production
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

There is no issue in dev environment but in production import.meta.glob transpiled to (void 0) when using in webworker and getting "Uncaught TypeError: (void 0) is not a function" error.

### Example Usage in Webworker
```
const modules = import.meta.glob('./*js')

onmessage = function(e) {
  console.log(e.data, modules)
}
```
transpiled to;
```
(function() {
    "use strict";
    const n = (void 0)("./*js");
    onmessage = function(o) {
        console.log(o.data, n)
    }
}
)();
```
### Reproduction

https://github.com/karatasebu/import.meta.glob-worker-issue

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 12.2.1
    CPU: (8) x64 Apple M1
    Memory: 23.45 MB / 8.00 GB
    Shell: 5.8 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 14.19.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.19.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.17 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 8.5.4 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.19.0/bin/npm
    Watchman: 2022.03.07.00 - /opt/homebrew/bin/watchman
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 100.0.4896.75
    Safari: 15.3
  npmPackages:
    @vitejs/plugin-vue: ^2.3.0 => 2.3.1 
    vite: ^2.9.0 => 2.9.1
```


### Used Package Manager

npm

### Logs

```shell
Uncaught TypeError: (void 0) is not a function
```
